seoTitle: Share Your TradingView Chart as Image, Link, or Tweet
metaDescription: Learn how to use TradingView's camera icon to download a chart image, copy it to your clipboard, share a link, or tweet it directly.
intro: TradingView makes it easy to share a chart setup with others, whether as a downloadable image, a direct link, or a tweet. This guide covers using the camera icon in the chart toolbar to access each of these sharing options.

steps.heading: Open your chart
steps.body: Display the chart you want to share in the chart section of TradingView.

steps.heading: Click the camera icon
steps.body: Find the camera icon in the upper right corner of the chart to access the sharing options.

steps.heading: Download the image
steps.body: Use the Download Image option to save a picture of your chart to your device for emails, presentations, or social media.

steps.heading: Copy the image to your clipboard
steps.body: Choose Copy Image if you'd rather paste the chart directly into a document or chat message without saving a file.

steps.heading: Copy a direct link
steps.body: Use the share link option to copy a URL others can open to view your chart setup in the same interactive format.

steps.heading: Tweet the image
steps.body: If you're active on Twitter, use the Tweet Image option to post your chart with a short message directly from TradingView.

faq.question: Where is the sharing option on TradingView?
faq.answer: Click the camera icon in the upper right corner of your chart to access all the sharing options.

faq.question: Can I share a chart without downloading it?
faq.answer: Yes, the Copy Image option copies the chart to your clipboard so you can paste it directly into a message or document.

faq.question: Can others view my chart as a live link?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView offers a direct link option so others can view your chart setup online in an interactive format.

faq.question: Can I tweet my chart directly from TradingView?
faq.answer: Yes, the Tweet Image option lets you post your chart with a message straight to Twitter.

faq.question: What image formats can I download?
faq.answer: TradingView generates a standard image file of your chart that you can attach to emails or upload to social platforms.
